body: After two days of overtime in Antalya, the final climate deal collapses — rejected over a text that never names fossil fuels, the first to admit the world's 1.5°C limit will be passed.
headline: COP31 ENDS WITHOUT A DEAL
label: CLIMATE

body: Special forces seize the FBI top-ten cartel boss in Sinaloa. Eleven people are killed in the violence that follows.
headline: MEXICO CAPTURES 'EL CHAPO ISIDRO'
label: JUSTICE

body: The Revolutionary Guard hits an industrial site; Bahrain says civilian property was struck. It is the fourth Gulf attack in nine days, with oil near $90.
headline: IRAN STRIKES BAHRAIN
label: MIDDLE EAST

body: A missile strike on Kryvyi Rih kills two and wounds dozens. Ukraine answers by setting a Russian military cargo ship ablaze in the Baltic.
headline: RUSSIA HITS ZELENSKY'S HOMETOWN
label: WAR

body: Brussels signing scraps duties on over 90% of goods traded between the two sides. The pact is expected in force in 2027.
headline: EU–INDONESIA DEAL SIGNED AFTER 10 YEARS
label: TRADE

body: Proof-checkers verify the 17-million-line formal proof Alpöge built with Claude. A rival human claim appeared the same day; formal acceptance is still pending.
headline: AI PROOF OF RIEMANN 'CHECKS OUT'
label: SCIENCE
